title: Boltzmann Dynamics in K-essence Cosmology: Photon Propagation in an Emergent Spacetime
summary: Recent cosmological tensions, notably the Hubble and $S_{8}$ tensions, motivate extensions of the conventional FLRW framework in which additional dynamical fields can alter the effective spacetime experienced by matter and radiation. In K-essence cosmology, the scalar field induces an emergent FLRW geometry disformally related to the gravitational metric, leading to a \emph{tilted causal structure} in which the photon light cone differs from that of gravity.
